text: Never open a connecting door while the train is inside a tunnel.
Never give the Conductor your true name.
The dead may travel forward, but never backward.
No passenger may enter the dining car twice.
The train only stops for someone who genuinely intends to leave.
Anything abandoned belongs to the train.
A passenger without a reflection must not be allowed to sleep.
When the bell rings three times, someone has been replaced.
Never count the windows in a sleeper carriage.
The engine cannot hear a person who has been completely forgotten.
A ticket punched with blood permits passage through locked doors.
Anyone who sees the final station must not describe it aloud.
